!3 CSV: how differences are reported
A path is row[N] (the data row, header excluded) and the column: row[4].amount, or row[4]['unit price'] when the name is not an identifier. Different headers give one difference and no row comparison. A missing row names the expected row and shows it.

|script|csv comparison|
|separator|;|
|check|compare;|{{{id;amount
1;10}}}|{{{id;amount
1;11}}}|!-<div><b>1 difference:</b><br>row[1].amount: expected <code>10</code> but was <code>11</code></div>-!|
|check|compare;|{{{id;unit price
1;3}}}|{{{id;unit price
1;4}}}|!-<div><b>1 difference:</b><br>row[1][&#39;unit price&#39;]: expected <code>3</code> but was <code>4</code></div>-!|
|check|compare;|{{{id;amount}}}|{{{id;total}}}|!-<div><b>1 difference:</b><br>header: expected <code>[id, amount]</code> but was <code>[id, total]</code></div>-!|
|check|compare;|{{{id;amount
1;2
7;3}}}|{{{id;amount
1;2}}}|!-<div><b>1 difference:</b><br>expected row[2]: missing <code>{id=7, amount=3}</code></div>-!|
|check|compare;|{{{id;amount
1;2}}}|{{{id;amount
1;2
9;9}}}|!-<div><b>1 difference:</b><br>row[2]: unexpected <code>{id=9, amount=9}</code></div>-!|
|note|the row below shows the HTML rendering in the extra cell|
|show|compare;|{{{id;label;amount
1;Widget;10
2;Gadget;20
3;Gizmo;30}}}|{{{id;label;amount
1;Widget;10.5
2;Gadget XL;20}}}|
